name: mobilepc-agent
description: AI-powered mobile-first remote computer control system using a local Windows agent and PeekWin.

scripts.build: npm -w @mobilepc/shared run build && npm -w @mobilepc/api run build && npm -w @mobilepc/windows-agent run build && npm -w @mobilepc/web run build
scripts.test: npm -w @mobilepc/shared run build && npm -w @mobilepc/shared run test && npm -w @mobilepc/api run test && npm -w @mobilepc/windows-agent run test
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @mobilepc/shared run typecheck && npm -w @mobilepc/api run typecheck && npm -w @mobilepc/windows-agent run typecheck && npm -w @mobilepc/web run typecheck
